Subject: Bachelor thesis idea — hope this is enough?

Dear Professor,

my name is Erika Musterfrau, matriculation number 00000000, I am in the 6th semester of Business Informatics and I would like to write my Bachelor's thesis under your supervision.

My idea: companies subscribe to many SaaS tools and over time nobody keeps track of what is actually used. I want to build a dashboard that scans which tools a company uses and shows the overlaps between them, so companies can cancel duplicates and save money. I think this is a real problem because I saw it at my working student job.

My plan would be: months 1-2 reading literature, months 3-4 implementing the dashboard, month 5 evaluation (maybe a survey?), month 6 writing everything up and buffer.

As sources I found two blog posts about "SaaS sprawl" that describe the problem well, and I could also cite the tool vendors' websites.

I hope this is roughly what you expect for a proposal. Could you tell me what is still missing?

Best regards,
